extraction_notes: [text-pass] The paper reports on (Ag0.366Sb0.558Te)1-x(SnTe)x solid solutions. While temperature-dependent plots (Fig 1 and Fig 3) are provided, they are graphical representations without explicit numerical values for specific data points in the text, except for the peak ZT values mentioned in the body text. [figure-pass p1-5] The paper investigates (Ag0.366Sb0.558Te)1-x(SnTe)x solid solutions. Thermoelectric properties (Seebeck, resistivity, power factor, thermal conductivity, ZT) are plotted as a function of temperature for various x values (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100 SnTe%). ZT values were extracted from the text description of Fig 3c.
